jobs.name: Job Repo
jobs.desc: A database of campus jobs in China with keyword and filter search and deadline reminders, plus an online resume builder and a data insights page. The site is in Chinese.

econ.name: Everyday Economics
econ.desc: An open data project built on official statistics that compares prices, wages and output per person, with a pay-versus-inflation calculator and a price time machine.

stutterScope.name: StutterScope
stutterScope.desc: A recorder for in-game micro-stutter on Windows. It lines up PresentMon per-frame data with CPU, GPU, disk, memory and background-process activity, can add WPR/ETW deep traces, and writes an offline HTML report when you close the recording window.
stutterScope.requirements: Windows 11 x64, needs administrator permission. Windows 10 not yet verified.

photoCard.name: Photo English Card
photoCard.desc: An Agent Skill that turns an everyday photo into a magazine-style English study poster: vocabulary, natural phrases, sentence patterns, a scene description and speaking prompts.

headshot.name: American Corporate Headshot
headshot.desc: An Agent Skill that edits a selfie or upper-body photo into a natural American corporate headshot for LinkedIn, resumes and personal sites. Choose from five styles, or get an English editing prompt when image tools are unavailable.
headshot.imageAlt: AI-generated fictional subject wearing dark round glasses, a navy blazer and a light-blue shirt against a warm-gray studio background

designMd.name: design-md
designMd.desc: An Agent Skill bundling 84 DESIGN.md design systems inspired by well-known products. Describe a style in plain words and the agent picks the closest one or two from a bilingual index, without loading the whole library into context. The design files come from VoltAgent/awesome-design-md.
highlights: Offers candidates when the style is vague

dshVercel.name: dsh-vercel
dshVercel.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to Vercel's official MCP server over OAuth, loads Vercel tools on demand in DSH chats, and bundles 34 official Vercel skill guides.
dshVercel.installNote: Desktop: initialize and fully quit DSH Desktop before installing, then restart it.

atollJelly.name: Atoll Jelly
atollJelly.desc: Six stilt houses, a seaplane and a few rays share a lagoon made of turquoise jelly. Stir the water or drop in a swimming ring and watch it drift.
highlights: Drag across the surface to send out ripples and watch the rings bob.
Orbit to the side to see rays swimming below the surface and the terrain through the jelly.
atollJelly.imageAlt: A turquoise jelly lagoon with stilt houses, a small island, a seaplane and floating rings, next to the control panel.
atollJelly.requirements: Requires a browser with WebGPU support.

bottledSea.name: Bottled Sea
bottledSea.desc: A voxel sailing ship passes a lighthouse above fish, coral and a sunken treasure chest. The whole scene fits inside a glass bottle lying on its side.
highlights: Hold Space or the storm button to rock the bottle. The water stays level overall, with the waves contained inside.
Speed up the day–night cycle and watch the lighthouse beam sweep across the water.
bottledSea.imageAlt: At dusk, a horizontal glass bottle holds a voxel sailing ship, a lighthouse and sunken treasure, with a telescope on the desk outside.
bottledSea.requirements: Requires a browser with WebGL support.

rainyNightStore.name: Rainy Night Convenience Store
rainyNightStore.desc: A miniature street corner floats in the dark. Amayado Mart lights up the wet crosswalk while a cat shelters under the awning.
highlights: Turn up the rain to see denser streaks and stronger ripples in the puddles.
Switch off the shop lights and their reflections fade from the wet road. A lightning flash briefly lights up the whole street corner.
rainyNightStore.imageAlt: Amayado Mart in the rain, with bright windows reflecting on wet pavement and layers of soil visible below the floating street corner.
rainyNightStore.requirements: Requires a browser with WebGL support.

pocketPlanet.name: 3D Pocket Planet
pocketPlanet.desc: Snowy mountains, a forest, a lake and a few houses dot this tiny world. Clouds and a hot-air balloon drift around it.
highlights: The tower clock shows your local time. Slide into night and watch the streetlights and windows light up one by one.
Click the balloon to send it on a higher lap before it returns to its usual orbit.
pocketPlanet.imageAlt: A low-poly planet against a deep blue sky, with a lake, a clock tower, houses along a path and a hot-air balloon overhead.
pocketPlanet.requirements: Requires a browser with WebGL support.
